caption:
Bob wanted to compliment his colleague's suit 👔🐜 …the whole office heard something else 🩲😳

In the UK, pants = underwear.
Say: "I like your trousers!" (UK) or "I like your pants!" (US)

Tag a friend who would say it like Bob 👇 Save it 📌
